characters.description: The Atwood ruler enters the fifth-pillar trial while his ice-sealed Draugr body recovers under Esmeralda's guidance. He is a Flame Bearer candidate with linked human and Draugr bodies.
characters.name: Zac

characters.description: Zac's contracted companion and a specialist in space, Esmeralda guides his frozen body into the trial while seeking a target connected to the Mercurial Court. Her repeated reincarnations qualify her for entry, but the temporal safeguard concealing their passage is nearly exhausted.
characters.name: Esmeralda

characters.description: The historical woman whose identity Zac shares while both attempt core breakthroughs inside a fortified Imperial node under attack.
characters.name: Wendemar daughter

characters.description: The Wendemar daughter's father and a formations master, he redirects the failing node's power and expends his own resources to hold back the assault while her breakthrough continues.
characters.name: Wendemar formations master

characters.description: An early monarch who governs a city built on a colossal skull, the mayor welcomes Zac as an Imperial hero because the memory recognizes his Wendemar identity. He offers hospitality to the apparent descendant of the city's founding family.
characters.name: Skull-city mayor

characters.description: Zac's demon companion and a shadow cultivator, Ogras completes the memory of an Imperial covert operative. He retains its Hollow Court identity and a disguised token, then sets out toward that court on a route separate from Zac's.
characters.name: Ogras

characters.description: An Atwood commander and seal bearer, Joanna is fighting alongside an elite Imperial unit inside a beast-tide memory when Zac finds her. She recognizes him as her sworn brother, and her standing with the soldiers grants him access to their defended position.
characters.name: Joanna

characters.description: A covert ally of Zac and a light-bringer associated with the Radiant Court, Carl follows the traces of a powerful fire cultivator. He identifies himself to Iz as Zac's janitor and asks to accompany her toward the Far Sea Court to improve Zac's prospects.
characters.name: Carl Elrod

characters.description: A Flame Bearer and ally of Zac, Iz is travelling toward the Far Sea Court when Carl catches up with her. She accepts him as a companion after recognizing the unusual conviction behind his fire-aligned path.
characters.name: Iz

characters.description: An extremely powerful insectoid who claims queenly status, Ronnie holds a Jix seal bearer captive. She rejects the captive's human-influenced cultivation path, destroys its prototype manual, and subjects it to genetic experimentation.
characters.name: Ronnie

characters.description: An unnamed Jix seal bearer who regards Zac as a benefactor, the captive is forced into Ronnie's service after she destroys a prototype cultivation manual and begins extracting traits through physical experimentation.
characters.name: Jix seal bearer

characters.description: A seal bearer on a separate route, Velary is pursuing the Pashohar Bell and developing an emotion-based spirit tool. Zac remains concerned about the coercive entity threatening her and hopes to help after finishing his own business at the Mercurial Court.
characters.name: Velary

characters.description: A late-hegemon trial taker protected by Imperial faith, this swordsman attacks through a captured technocrat operative. His rapid strikes disrupt Zac's energy, and his apparent goal is to force Zac into exposing powers he is determined to keep hidden.
characters.name: Imperial swordsman

characters.description: A retired three-star Phoenix Legion veteran and peak middle hegemon, he hides his former rank while serving as a rural guardsman after the near-destruction of his legion. Zac inhabits his identity when the veteran intervenes against an attack on a remote farming region.
characters.name: Phoenix Legion veteran

characters.description: An apparently mortal child protected by Fertile Earth priests becomes Zac’s escort objective after technocrats pursue the group. The child shows awareness of Zac beyond the identity he occupies in the memory and speaks to him in an ancient voice.
characters.name: Earth child

characters.description: The Earth child identifies himself as Roan and reveals awareness spanning connected memory realms. He carries a stone matching Zac’s hidden void relic, leads Zac toward another confrontation, and conveys an ancient consciousness’s offer to unseal the relic if Zac survives.
characters.name: Roan

characters.description: A weakened fate-calculating cultivator from the Radiant Temple, the numerologist is beside Ogras when Zac emerges from the Fertile Earth memory.
characters.name: Radiant Temple numerologist

characters.description: Zac's axe tool spirit takes the form of a hyena and remains beside him when a burst of ancient Dao overwhelms his soul.
characters.name: Axe tool spirit

characters.description: Zac's unnamed sealed toad companion opens a slain Reaver leader's spatial ring, selects two items under their agreement, and helps assess the remaining loot. It then continues separately toward the Hollow Court.
characters.name: Sealed toad companion

characters.description: The covert heir behind a mining expedition, the Whitecrest scion seeks an ancient array-breaking inheritance as an offering to a powerful patron. The scion joins Zac and Ogras in a forced descent into the Muddy Patch under the watch of two Void Heralds.
characters.name: Whitecrest scion

characters.description: The elderly head of the Serpico mining guild, the guildmaster resists Zac's request to join the Muddy Patch expedition. He is concerned that the guild's covert patrons intend to sacrifice the miners during the excavation.
characters.name: Serpico guildmaster

characters.description: A senior member of the Wendemar clan whose Dao avatar intervenes against the Serpico guildmaster. He recognizes that Zac bears a foreign temporal connection to the clan seal and concludes that Zac comes from another time.
characters.name: Wendemar elder

characters.description: The armored master of Kala Sutra recognizes Zac’s void-based path during an encounter with an intact coffin procession. The realm lord precisely applies death to heal Zac’s wounds, removes escaping Eclipse Twin energy, and grants him a benediction connected to the Nine Gardens and eight hells.
characters.name: Kala Sutra realm lord

characters.description: A sword cultivator believed dead, Thea's appearance is used by an intruder who breaches Velary's sentry after the fifth emotion idol is contained. At this point, Velary cannot tell whether the visitor is genuinely Thea or someone wearing a convincing disguise.
characters.name: Thea Marshall

characters.description: Zac's willing axe spirit seeks a middle D-grade advancement because her current weapon grade has fallen behind his cultivation. She proposes using the dangerous curse-linked flame beneath Terran's Loom to reforge herself.
characters.name: Alea

characters.description: An unidentified trial participant attuned to flame, space, and formations, the elemental repairs a nurturing array around the curse-linked spiritual flame beneath Terran’s Loom. Its work could let the flame consume the city, though its full purpose is not yet established.
characters.name: Terran’s Loom elemental

characters.description: One of Terran's Loom's foremost local blacksmiths, she was detained after trying to destroy the volcano above a tainted flame. She agrees to help reforge Alea only after Zac promises to address the wider curse threatening the city.
characters.name: Terran's Loom blacksmith

characters.description: A sound-division inner disciple of the Joyful Gardens, she notices Zac's life affinity and invites him to a private performance.
characters.name: Joyful Gardens music cultivator

characters.description: A dead inner disciple whose consciousness appears within the monstrous garden spirit attacking Zac. She may be another victim or the force directing the creature, and the truth remains unclear when Zac brings the unstable entity before the Joyful Gardens elders.
characters.name: Corrupted garden disciple

characters.description: A high-status enkindling sage of a Templar order approaches Zac in a water-built city memory. Accompanied by a concealed Dao Guardian, the young Templar takes an unusual interest in Zac and questions the identity he presents.
characters.name: Young Templar

characters.description: Zac's disciple and an Atwood combat leader, Emily appears through the identity of an Order of Dawn infiltrator caught inside a cult's sun-deity ritual. With embedded Templars exposed as sacrifices, she must decide how to aid the surviving infiltrators.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: A claimant from the ruling dynasty, this trial taker uses a key relic and ancient arcana to corrupt a memory lantern. He is attempting to redirect the trial's fate toward his own prospective path to imperial power.
characters.name: Royal trial taker

characters.description: A high-level Buddhist warrior, the envoy interrupts the royal claimant's manipulation of a memory lantern. The envoy's faction seeks to free spirits that continue unnaturally within the trial's inner memory layer.
characters.name: Dharmic envoy

characters.description: A member of Zac's cycle, Kruta appears within the memory as an orc army inspector working beside Joanna. Together they investigate how a noble officer's leak led rebels to ambush an elite battalion and kill tens of thousands of Imperial soldiers.
characters.name: Kruta

characters.description: An unnamed traveller operating a modified Realm Keeper orb, the observer contacts a temporal scholar and warns that the scholar's planned prototype will erase an academy. The observer demonstrates the predicted disaster through an elaborate temporal experience.
characters.name: Realm Keeper observer
